hero.title: Data Management
hero.lead: INPUT SOFT Data Management Software Suite captures, analyzes, and invoices everything that happens on the ramp, from ground services to GSE usage. Every turnaround is billed accurately, with no service left out.

items.title: Flight services
items.text: Digital tracking of turnaround operations that eliminates paper logs and captures precise timestamps, passenger data, and cargo details.

items.title: Invoicing
items.text: Automated invoicing engine that matches completed ramp services against airline contracts and SGHA terms to calculate exact charges.

items.title: GSE control
items.text: Centralized management hub that monitors equipment availability, tracks usage metrics, and forecasts technical maintenance based on real-world data.

modules.title: Flight Services Module
paragraphs: Log precise ground operations timestamps, flight statuses, delay codes, and actual passenger or cargo volumes right at the aircraft using the mobile iOS/Android app.
Compile all verified field data into a centralized web dashboard to replace paper logs with a clear timeline for every flight. All the data and views are fully customizable.

modules.title: Invoicing Module
paragraphs: Add airline contracts, like SGHA, to the directory. The system automatically matches ramp data with these contracts to calculate rates and generate ready-to-send invoices.
Issue invoices and scan operational records automatically. The system flags missing invoices to stop revenue leakage, allows issuing credit notes, and tracks any work for audit purposes.

modules.title: GSE Control Module
paragraphs: Complete mandatory pre-shift GSE inspections and record engine hours, mileage, fuel levels and any other required information directly via mobile checklists before operating any asset.
Analyze logged equipment data on the web platform to track vehicle availability, automatically predict maintenance needs based on real usage and export the GSE reports.

rows.title: Mobile app: built for the ramp
paragraphs: Eliminates delayed reporting and manual data re-entry by allowing ground staff to input checklists and service logs directly on mobile devices in real time.
Instant updates: get push notifications for task changes, flight delays, or reassignments as they happen.
